local_mcp_half.note: install/enable/authorize are implemented canonically for CLI and dashboard (confirm-gated /api/mcp/*), and as the desktop-only setup_mcp tool. Not exposed as a model toolset for non-desktop sessions, so a migrated platform_toolsets entry named 'connections' resolves zero tools.
qubit_names: voicebridge/qubit_compat.py: h_mcp_servers / mcp_create / mcp_set_enabled / mcp_auth / h_mcp_catalog_live

managed_connector_half.prerequisite: external Qubit/Hermes tool-gateway service + account auth
managed_connector_half.reason: status/connect/reconnect require the upstream tool gateway (gateway.sock / portal account authorization) that Qubit deliberately does not run; no local counterpart exists.

upstream_definition.description: Remote connector discovery, execution, and account authorization

moa.note: 'moa' appears in the live ~/.hermes platform_toolsets.cli list but is absent from both TOOLSETS dicts; Hermes _get_platform_tools('cli') drops it. It is the virtual Mixture-of-Agents provider, not a toolset.

kanban.description: Kanban multi-agent coordination — only active when the agent is spawned by the kanban dispatcher (HERMES_KANBAN_TASK env set). The dispatcher runs inside the gateway by default; see `kanban.dispatch_in_gateway` in config.yaml. Lets workers mark tasks done with structured handoffs, enter first-class review (request_review — not a block), return review changes, block for human input, heartbeat during long ops, comment on threads, attach files, and (for orchestrators) list, unblock, and fan out tasks.

video_gen.description: Video generation tools. Single ``video_generate`` tool covers text-to-video (prompt only) and image-to-video (prompt + image_url), plus reference-to-video. Provider-specific edit/extend workflows may appear as separate tools. Configure via ``hermes tools`` → Video Generation.

web.description: Web research and content extraction tools

x_search.description: Search X (Twitter) posts and threads via xAI's built-in x_search Responses tool. Read-only public X discovery; use the xurl skill for authenticated X API reads and account actions. Available when xAI credentials are configured (SuperGrok OAuth or XAI_API_KEY). Off by default; enable in `hermes tools` → X (Twitter) Search.
